implemented_requirements.requirement: Add, edit, and delete financial transactions
implemented_requirements.evidence: BudgetTracker.add_transaction, update_transaction, delete_transaction in tracker.py; GUI buttons _on_add_transaction, _on_update_transaction, _on_delete_transaction in gui.py

implemented_requirements.requirement: Persist transactions and budgets between runs
implemented_requirements.evidence: JSONStorage.load and save in storage.py; BudgetTracker._persist called after each mutation

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display total income, expenses, and savings
implemented_requirements.evidence: BudgetTracker.get_total_income, get_total_expenses, get_savings; GUI summary_var and dashboard cards updated in _render_summary_labels

implemented_requirements.requirement: Compare income vs expenses per month
Set and monitor monthly budgets per category
implemented_requirements.evidence: BudgetTracker.set_budget, remove_budget, get_budget_status; GUI budget tab with _on_set_budget, _on_remove_budget, _render_budget_status
BudgetTracker.get_monthly_summary; GUI reports tab renders table in _render_reports
Tkinter based GUI in gui.py with tabs for Transactions, Dashboard, Budgets, Reports; entry point in main.py
Category class in models.py (and duplicate in category.py) with EXPENSE_CATEGORIES and INCOME_CATEGORIES; used in GUI combo boxes

critical_issues: A stray file transaction.py contains an incomplete stub of a Transaction class; it is not imported anywhere, so it does not affect execution but could cause confusion.
If matplotlib is not installed the dashboard charts are disabled; the application still runs but visual monitoring is limited.
judge.summary: The repository provides a complete, functional budget tracker with transaction CRUD, persistence, summary calculations, budgeting, and visual dashboards. Core features are implemented and wired into a Tkinter GUI, and the code appears runnable given standard Python libraries and optional matplotlib. Minor issues (unused stub file and optional dependency) do not prevent the main functionality, resulting in a passing assessment.
